title: Samples from the Baltic Sea anomaly test as burned organic material

tellings.quote: when we did the samples there from uh uh we take from not from the object, but from that laying on the object. Uh it was organic burned natural.

plain: The Baltic Sea anomaly is a strangely shaped object on the floor of the Baltic Sea that a treasure-hunting team found and that some call a UFO on the seabed. The treasure hunter Dennis Asberg, who led the dives, tells Michels that in 2011 and 2012 they took samples, not from the object itself but from material lying on it, and that the result was "organic burned natural" matter.
